zh-CN.page_note: 原生串口 · 可视化流程 · 工程可独立运行
zh-CN.reconnect_note: 默认关闭。VID、PID、端口与物理拓扑必须完全一致；缺少标识须手动打开。
zh-CN.overflow_note: 接收队列过载将断开并锁存；排除故障后点击“手动打开”恢复。
zh-CN.history_empty: 打开串口后，真实收发数据将在这里显示
zh-CN.history_limit: 保留最近 500 条 / 512 KiB，淘汰旧记录数：
zh-CN.payload_hint: 输入 UTF-8 文本，或完整 HEX 字节（例如 01 A0 FF）
zh-CN.send_note: 写入完成不代表设备应答。断开、错误、重连后均停止定时发送。

en.page_note: Native serial · Visual flows · Standalone project
en.reconnect_text: Reconnect only to the same device
en.reconnect_note: Off by default. VID, PID, port and physical topology must match. Missing identity requires manual open.
en.overflow_note: RX overload disconnects and latches the fault. Resolve it, then open manually.
en.history_empty: Open a serial port to receive real traffic
en.payload_hint: UTF-8 text, or complete HEX bytes such as 01 A0 FF
en.send_note: Write completion is not device acknowledgement. Disconnects, errors and reconnects stop periodic sends.
